build_note: Hexoptics C44 first (55 AD + 25% crit) - Jhin gains AD from crit, so crit items scale his base damage. RFC second (25% crit, 50% total) for the empowered long-range 4th shot. IE third (IE passive active at 50%+ crit before adding IE's own). 4th shot crits with RFC for 30%+ HP on squishies. W root from fog of war wins trades.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 4th - armor pen amplifies his fixed-damage 4th shot
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies - never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs heavy dive - delays IE one slot
kit_notes: Jhin has 4 shots then a reload - plan your 4th shot as the crit/execute. W (Deadly Flourish) roots enemies who have been hit by minions or allies recently - look for rooted kills in ARAM constant damage. Lotus Trap (E) slows approaching enemies - place at health pack paths. Curtain Call (R) from safe angle after engage.
aram_specific: The ARAM corridor means every 4th shot can hit grouped enemies. Use W roots to lock down grouped fights. Position behind your frontline - his reload is a vulnerability window. Lotus Traps slow enemies approaching your side. R from behind cover after your team engages.
